instruction: A clean studio photograph captured in a high-angle full shot. In a minimalist white studio with a seamless white floor, the woman in the white outfit (R2) on the right performs a dramatic high kick, extending her right leg straight up into the air while balancing on her left leg. On the left, the woman in the black outfit (R1) ducks low to the ground, leaning her torso to the left with her arms outstretched for balance. The two barefoot dancers create a highly dynamic, athletic composition. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft, elongated shadows on the white floor.
